class.name: LaserVolley2D
class.brief_description: One laser shot: a beam per pattern slot, ticked, drawn and pooled by the factory.
class.description: Created by [LaserSpawner2D] and [method BulletFactory2D.spawn_laser] (never instantiate it yourself). Every beam follows its [LaserData2D] (read every tick: edits reach it) through the phases, aims, sweeps, stops or reflects at walls and hits what it touches. Its signals fire on its owner spawner while that lives, else on the [BulletFactory2D] (never both). A finished laser goes back to the factory's pool (by beam count) and comes back with a clean life; [method get_life_id] tells lives apart. Drawing is interpolated while the factory's physics interpolation is active.

method.name: debug_check_invariants
method.description: Returns an empty String when the laser's state is consistent (a pooled laser holds nothing, every beam has finite geometry), else what is wrong.

method.name: debug_get_draw_state
method.description: Returns, per beam, exactly what the next draw uses at [param fraction] (-1 = the interpolation fraction now, 1 = this tick): [code]points[/code], [code]width[/code], [code]color[/code], [code]warning[/code], the [code]charge[/code] / [code]body[/code] / [code]muzzle[/code] / [code]tip[/code] frames, [code]pierces[/code] and [code]impacts[/code] ([position, frame] pairs) and [code]spent[/code].

method.name: end_laser
method.description: Ends the laser: fading ([param fade]) or at once. Its contacts end and the phase is announced on the next tick. Safe from handlers.

method.name: get_active_time_left
method.description: Seconds of the active phase left (its whole length before it started, 0 when it lasts until ended or is over).

method.name: get_anchor
method.description: Returns the node the muzzles follow, or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_beam_angle
method.description: Returns where beam [param beam_index] points now, in radians (a bolt's or curvy laser's heading).

method.name: get_beam_count
method.description: Returns how many beams this laser has (0 while pooled).

method.name: get_beam_end
method.description: Returns the end of beam [param beam_index]: the tip of a beam, the head of a bolt or curvy laser.

method.name: get_beam_length
method.description: Returns the drawn and damaging length of beam [param beam_index] now (cut by walls and [member LaserData2D.pierce_limit]).

method.name: get_beam_points
method.description: Returns the beam's polyline: from its start to its end, reflection points in between (a curvy body's path).

method.name: get_beam_start
method.description: Returns the start of beam [param beam_index]: the muzzle of a beam, the tail of a bolt or curvy laser.

method.name: get_beam_wall_normal
method.description: Returns the normal of the wall beam [param beam_index] last stopped at.

method.name: get_beam_wall_point
method.description: Returns where beam [param beam_index] last stopped at a wall.

method.name: get_current_width
method.description: Returns the width drawn now: the warning width while charging, else [member LaserData2D.width] scaled by the growing or fading phase.

method.name: get_laser_data
method.description: Returns the laser's data.

method.name: get_life_id
method.description: Returns the id of this life (it changes every time the pool hands the laser out again).

method.name: get_owner_spawner
method.description: Returns the spawner that fired the laser, or [code]null[/code] (a factory laser, or its spawner is gone).

method.name: get_phase
method.description: Returns the phase now (see [enum LaserPhase]).

method.name: get_phase_time
method.description: Returns the seconds spent in the current phase.

method.name: get_pierced_targets
method.description: Returns the targets beam [param beam_index] touches now, nearest first.

method.name: is_beam_blocked
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while beam [param beam_index] is stopped by a wall.

method.name: is_laser_active
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while the laser fires (from the shot until it finishes).

method.name: is_pooled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while the laser waits in the factory's pool (a stale handle).

method.name: set_active_time_left
method.description: Sets the seconds of the active phase left (before it started: its length). 0 = until ended. Must be finite and >= 0.

method.name: set_anchor
method.description: Makes the muzzles follow [param anchor] from where they are now ([code]null[/code] = stay).

method.name: set_beam_angle
method.description: Turns beam [param beam_index] so it points along [param radians] now (its pattern aim; a sweep goes on from there).

method.name: set_beam_target
method.description: Sets the target of beam [param beam_index] for Track and Lock On: a [Node2D], a [Vector2] position, or [code]null[/code] (no target).

method.name: set_targets
method.description: Sets every beam's target: beam [code]i[/code] takes [code]targets[i % size][/code] (a [Node2D] or a [Vector2]). An empty array clears them.

constants.constant: The width grows from 0 (hits with [member LaserData2D.hit_while_growing]).
The width shrinks to 0, no hits.
Over: the laser is pooled right after [signal BulletFactory2D.laser_finished].
